adjust_description: DEFINE_ADJUST: be called by Fluent at the end of every iteration.
init_description: DEFINE_INIT: be called once right after the flow field is initialized.
execute_at_end_description: DEFINE_EXECUTE_AT_END: be called after the calculation (or each time step) completes.
on_demand_description: DEFINE_ON_DEMAND: be invoked manually by the user through Execute on Demand.
rw_file_description: DEFINE_RW_FILE: write user data to, or read it back from, case/data files.
deltat_description: DEFINE_DELTAT: return the adaptive time step size for the next time step.
set_deltat_description: Store the adaptive time step size DEFINE_DELTAT returns as an assignment without returning immediately; usable inside DEFINE_DELTAT only.
end_deltat_description: End the time step macro: return the stored time step size; usable inside DEFINE_DELTAT only.
from_gui_description: DEFINE_EXECUTE_FROM_GUI: be invoked from a user-defined panel with a message code.
translation_unit_description: A UDF source file: hosts the DEFINE_* macros and global declarations, and compiles into a C translation unit including udf.h.
profile_description: DEFINE_PROFILE: specify a boundary condition profile that varies over a boundary zone.
source_description: DEFINE_SOURCE: define the source term of a transport equation, with optional linearization.
set_source_const_description: Store the source value DEFINE_SOURCE returns (the zero-order term) as an assignment without returning immediately; usable inside DEFINE_SOURCE only.
set_source_diff_description: Set the derivative of the source term with respect to the equation variable, compiled as dS[equation]=expression; usable inside DEFINE_SOURCE only.
end_source_description: End the source macro: return the stored source value; usable inside DEFINE_SOURCE only.
property_description: DEFINE_PROPERTY: define a cell-wise material property such as density or viscosity.
set_property_description: Store the property value DEFINE_PROPERTY returns as an assignment without returning immediately; usable inside DEFINE_PROPERTY only.
end_property_description: End the property macro: return the stored property value; usable inside DEFINE_PROPERTY only.
diffusivity_description: DEFINE_DIFFUSIVITY: define the diffusivity of a species or user-defined scalar transport equation.
turbulent_viscosity_description: DEFINE_TURBULENT_VISCOSITY: compute the turbulent viscosity in place of the built-in turbulence models.
prandtl_description: DEFINE_PRANDTL: define a local Prandtl number.
turb_schmidt_description: DEFINE_TURB_SCHMIDT: define the turbulent Schmidt number of a species.
specific_heat_description: DEFINE_SPECIFIC_HEAT: return the specific heat and set the sensible enthalpy of a material.
heat_flux_description: DEFINE_HEAT_FLUX: modify the modeling of the wall heat flux through the diffusive and radiative coefficient arrays.
vr_rate_description: DEFINE_VR_RATE: define the rate of a volumetric reaction for the species transport model.
sr_rate_description: DEFINE_SR_RATE: define the rate of a surface (wall) reaction.
cavitation_rate_description: DEFINE_CAVITATION_RATE: define the cavitation mass transfer rate of the mixture multiphase model.
nox_rate_description: DEFINE_NOX_RATE: define the NOx formation rate that can replace, or add to, the internally-calculated rate.
sox_rate_description: DEFINE_SOX_RATE: define the SOx formation rate that can replace, or add to, the internally-calculated rate.
cphi_description: DEFINE_CPHI: define the mixing coefficient C_phi of the composition PDF transport model.
mass_transfer_description: DEFINE_MASS_TRANSFER: define the mass transfer rate between two phases of a multiphase flow.
exchange_property_description: DEFINE_EXCHANGE_PROPERTY: define the exchange property between two phases of a multiphase flow.
vector_exchange_property_description: DEFINE_VECTOR_EXCHANGE_PROPERTY: define the vector exchange property between two phases of a multiphase flow.
dpm_injection_init_description: DEFINE_DPM_INJECTION_INIT: be called when a discrete phase injection is initialized.
dpm_law_description: DEFINE_DPM_LAW: define a custom integration law for discrete phase particles.
dpm_drag_description: DEFINE_DPM_DRAG: define a custom drag coefficient for discrete phase particles.
dpm_body_force_description: DEFINE_DPM_BODY_FORCE: define an additional body force on discrete phase particles.
dpm_source_description: DEFINE_DPM_SOURCE: add the discrete phase source terms to the continuous phase equations.
dpm_bc_description: DEFINE_DPM_BC: customize the behavior of discrete phase particles at a boundary.
grid_motion_description: DEFINE_GRID_MOTION: define the motion of the nodes of a dynamic mesh zone.
cg_motion_description: DEFINE_CG_MOTION: define the translational and rotational velocities of a rigid body of the dynamic mesh.
dom_source_description: DEFINE_DOM_SOURCE: define the emission, in-scattering and absorption/scattering coefficients of the discrete ordinates radiation model.
emissivity_weighting_factor_description: DEFINE_EMISSIVITY_WEIGHTING_FACTOR: define the emissivity weighting factor for gray-band radiation of the discrete ordinates model.
thread_cell_description: thread_loop_c: traverse every cell thread of the domain.
thread_face_description: thread_loop_f: traverse every face thread of the domain.
cell_loop_description: begin_c_loop: traverse every cell of one thread.
face_of_cell_description: c_face_loop: traverse every face bounding one cell (use with C_FACE and C_FACE_THREAD).
node_of_cell_description: c_node_loop: traverse every node of one cell (use with C_NODE).
validate_empty_name: the name must not be empty
validate_empty_arg: the parameter identifier must not be empty
placeholder_body: Write code directly here, or insert components through completion
ctx_cell_thread_place: where a cell and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside a DEFINE_* macro or a cell traversal loop)
ctx_face_thread_place: where a face and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside DEFINE_HEAT_FLUX or DEFINE_SR_RATE)
ctx_domain_place: where the domain is in scope (e.g. inside DEFINE_ADJUST, DEFINE_INIT or a thread traversal loop)
ctx_thread_place: where a thread is in scope (e.g. inside a DEFINE_* macro or a traversal loop)
set_udmi_description: Write a value into an entry of the cell user-defined memory, compiled as an assignment; usable where a cell and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside a DEFINE_* macro or a cell traversal loop) only.
api_f_profile: the profile value stored on the face at the index
api_c_profile: the profile value stored on the cell at the index
api_f_area: compute the face area vector (into x)
api_f_flux: the mass flux through the face
api_f_flux_i: the mass flux of the phase at the index through the face
api_f_vof: the volume fraction at the face
api_f_yi: the mass fraction of the species at the index at the face
api_f_c0: the cell the face borders on its c0 side
api_f_c1: the cell the face borders on its c1 side
api_c_face: the n-th face of the cell
api_c_face_thread: the thread of the cell's n-th face
api_c_node: the n-th node of the cell
api_nd_nd: the spatial dimension of the computation
api_nv_v: assign vector v componentwise from an expression
api_nv_vv: vector combination a = b + c (operator replaceable)
api_nv_mag: compute the magnitude of a vector
api_nv_dot: compute the dot product of two vectors
api_message: print a message to the Fluent console
api_lookup_thread: look up a thread by its identifier
api_phase_index: the index of the phase the current thread belongs to, compiled as PHASE_INDEX(thread); usable where a thread is in scope (e.g. inside a DEFINE_* macro or a traversal loop)
api_c_udsi: the user-defined scalar of the cell at the index
api_c_udsi_g: the gradient of the user-defined scalar of the cell at the index (vector)
api_c_vof: the volume fraction of the phase at the index in the cell
api_c_yi: the mass fraction of the species at the index in the cell
api_thread_sub_thread: the sub-thread of the phase at the index out of a mixture thread; usable where a thread is in scope (e.g. inside a DEFINE_* macro or a traversal loop)
api_x_component: the x component of a vector
api_y_component: the y component of a vector
api_z_component: the z component of a vector
face_loop_description: begin_f_loop: traverse every face of one thread.
set_cell_user_scalar_description: Set the value of an entry of the cell user-defined scalar (C_UDSI); usable where a cell and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside a DEFINE_* macro or a cell traversal loop).
set_cell_profile_description: Set the cell profile value (C_PROFILE); usable where a cell and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside the cell traversal loop of a DEFINE_PROFILE boundary thread).
set_face_profile_description: Set the face profile value (F_PROFILE); usable where a face and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside the face traversal loop of a DEFINE_PROFILE boundary thread).
set_face_user_memory_description: Set the value of an entry of the face user-defined memory (F_UDMI); usable where a face and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside a DEFINE_* macro or a face traversal loop).
set_cell_volume_fraction_description: Set the cell volume fraction (C_VOF); usable where a cell and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside a DEFINE_* macro or a cell traversal loop).
set_cell_temperature_description: Set the cell temperature (C_T); usable where a cell and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside DEFINE_INIT, DEFINE_ADJUST or a cell traversal loop).
set_cell_pressure_description: Set the cell pressure (C_P); usable where a cell and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside DEFINE_INIT, DEFINE_ADJUST or a cell traversal loop).
set_cell_x_velocity_description: Set the cell x velocity (C_U); usable where a cell and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside DEFINE_INIT, DEFINE_ADJUST or a cell traversal loop).
set_cell_y_velocity_description: Set the cell y velocity (C_V); usable where a cell and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside DEFINE_INIT, DEFINE_ADJUST or a cell traversal loop).
set_cell_z_velocity_description: Set the cell z velocity (C_W); usable where a cell and its thread are in scope (e.g. inside DEFINE_INIT, DEFINE_ADJUST or a cell traversal loop).
